specification.title: One session of runner A ends while A is inside the migration
steps: List runner A's sessions by application_name ppcs-A. Terminate one of them with pg_terminate_backend. The choice does not depend on which session holds the framework's lock.
Runner B applies { m1 }. For the bound, B may exit, reach the gate, or stay blocked on the framework's own coordination.
Release K. A and B finish within the deadline. Runner C applies { m1 }.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as the last runner has returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: After every runner has finished, the migration's marker count is 1 and history holds one entry for it.

If any single session of runner A ends while A is inside the migration, either A's execution of it does not commit, or no other runner executes it before A finishes: its marker count is 1. Judged only when the session actually ended; otherwise the case is INCONCLUSIVE.
No runner starts executing the migration while another runner's execution of it is still live (its session still inside the migration): two live sessions inside it at once is a violation.

execution.description: Database.BeginTransactionAsync, CommitAsync, and RollbackAsync. Marker inserts use Database.ExecuteSqlAsync. The native TX-01A violation is SaveChangesAsync, which EF Core wraps in a savepoint. Nested scopes use CreateSavepointAsync. Pooling is false. EnableRetryOnFailure is not called. The provider's default execution strategy is left in place.

configuration.writes: Database.ExecuteSqlAsync for markers; SaveChangesAsync for the native TX-01A unique violation
configuration.savepoints: CreateSavepointAsync, RollbackToSavepointAsync, ReleaseSavepointAsync; SaveChangesAsync may create its own savepoint
configuration.execution_strategy: the provider default; EnableRetryOnFailure is not called

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

fault.mechanism: pg_terminate_backend() of one session of runner A, chosen by application_name ppcs-A, without knowing which session coordinates.
fault.injection_point: While A's migration waits at the gate, after its marker insert.
fault.expected_server: The session ends. Session-scoped locks it held are released. Its open transaction, if any, aborts.
fault.expected_client: The client of that session sees the connection drop.

knowledge: The runner whose session ended can see the connection error. Another runner cannot see, from the database alone, that the ended session was the one holding coordination.

error.message: An exception has been raised that is likely due to a transient failure.

api_error.message: An exception has been raised that is likely due to a transient failure.

B.basis: Database.MigrateAsync returned and EF logged that it was applying the migration
B.contract: EF Core 10 Database.MigrateAsync applies pending migrations compiled in this assembly, or moves to a target migration. On PostgreSQL the relational provider runs each migration in a transaction when the provider reports transactional migrations. This adapter does not take an advisory lock of its own before reading history. The migration SQL inserts the marker and, when the case holds the gate, waits on pg_advisory_xact_lock inside that migration. History is the table ef_migrations_history. The adapter reports applied when EF logs Applying migration, and nothing_to_do when MigrateAsync returns without that log. MigrateAsync("0") runs the Down method. An exception whose message says the migration has no reversal is reported as refused. Any other exception is reported as failed.

C.basis: Database.MigrateAsync returned without logging that it applied a migration
